caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular religious picture framed in a decorative tin frame. The frame is predominantly colored in shades of gray, with noticeable depth and three-dimensionality created by shading. It has a scalloped inner border around the central image. The central image, which is in muted brown and beige tones, portrays a figure standing upright, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a poncho or cape, and a skirt or robe. The figure holds a staff in the left hand and another object in the right hand. The lower part of the image contains text that reads “SANTONINO DE ATOCHA.” Above the frame, a green loop is attached, suggesting that the picture is meant to be hung. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and below the frame, there is a hand-written label that reads: “Religious Picture Framed in Tin~” and “Mabel G. Chiplin – Taos. N. M.”
title: Hand Drawn "Santo Nino de Atocha"-Hand Made Tin Frame
